_doc: Aether Sigil rules tables. ONE file for every number and interpretation the bible does not define.
The bible (AETHER_SIGIL_MASTER_GAME_BIBLE.json) stays the source of truth for maps, rosters, monsters and dialogue; nothing here edits it.
Coordinates: a tile [x, y] in the bible means map_grid[y][x] (544 of 564 objective tiles agree with this reading; 465 with the transpose).

damage._doc: damage = max(1, attack - defense). Then x advantage_mult if the attacker's family beats the defender's, x disadvantage_mult if the defender's family beats the attacker's (floored, min 1). Light and Dark beat each other.

element_chart._doc: The bible and PDF define 12 element_families but no relationships, so this chart is original. Each family beats exactly 2 and is beaten by exactly 2 (balanced). Only Light<->Dark is mutual.

terrain_bonus._doc: A monster on a terrain tile matching its element_family gets +family_atk attack and +family_def defense ('terrain advantage zones'). 'mixed' gives every family +mixed_def defense. Elevation and stone bonuses below are terrain bonuses too, so 'Terrain bonuses are doubled' doubles all of them.

tiles._doc: Every tile type in the legend of all 120 maps, plus 'stone' (used on maps but missing from every legend). walkable=false blocks movement. move_cost is movement points to enter. raise is the drawn block height (0..1).

stone._doc: Not in any legend (data finding). Treated as raised stone cover: +2 defense.

bridge._doc: Crossable chokepoint: walkable, 1-wide by map design. AI styles value holding it.

capsule_node._doc: Deployment/recharge node. Captured by ending your turn on it. Owner may deploy onto it; owner's units starting a turn on it heal recharge_pct of max HP.

relic._doc: Optional scoring objective. Secured by ending your turn on it; counts toward 'secure 3 relic nodes'.

warp_gate._doc: Teleport tile. Every map has at most ONE gate, so there is no gate-to-gate link (data finding). Gates are dormant unless the stage rule 'One random portal activates each round' activates one; an active gate sends a unit that ends its move on it to the mirrored tile (11-x, 11-y), or the nearest free walkable tile to it.

elevation._doc: High ground: +3 attack, +1 range, costs 2 to climb onto.

hazard._doc: A unit ending its owner's turn here takes hazard_damage_per_tier x tier, tier parsed from the stage's 'X hazard tier N' (1 if absent).

crystal._doc: The 'Crystal' element is in the Earth family; crystal also reads as arcane, so both match.

symbol._doc: Symbol HP/defense are not in the data. A Symbol blocks movement and is attacked like a unit with no element.

ap._doc: Action points exist only for 'Capsules cost 1 AP to deploy'. Without that rule deploying is free.

special_rules._doc: Rule table keyed by the exact special_rule text in the bible. Any text not listed here is reported as unimplemented by tests/test_data.gd.

Movement after a knockout is +1._doc: After a side KOs an enemy monster, all its monsters get +1 move for the rest of that turn and its next turn.

starter_team._doc: The player's starting 5. One per role (Guardian, Striker, Artillery, Scout, Support), five different families, chosen as the strongest Common/Uncommon of each role by hp/5 + 1.5*atk + def + 3*move + 3*range. In this data rarity does not predict stats (Commons average the same as every tier).
